title: Decoded stream event entry (v1)
description: One decoded event of the ordered array a buffered streaming envelope carries in data.upstream: the event's decode ordinal, its kind, and the members its kind carries — the exact text of a text run, the tag name and parsed payload of a documented tag, the name and raw text of an unknown tag, or the framing reason of a passthrough chunk.

text.$comment: kind text: the exact text run.

tag.$comment: kind tag and unknown_tag: the tag's name.

payload.$comment: kind tag: the validated JSON payload, carried as parsed. The decoder guarantees exactly one valid JSON document; the documented tag shapes are unverified upstream, so any JSON value rides here, not only an object.

raw.$comment: kind unknown_tag: the raw payload text exactly as the stream carried it.

reason.$comment: kind passthrough: what the chunk carried instead of answer content — role, tool_calls, finish_reason, empty choices, or no content.

allOf.$comment: kind text carries the exact text run.
kind tag carries the tag's name and parsed payload.
kind unknown_tag carries the tag's name and raw payload text.
kind passthrough carries what the chunk held instead of answer content.
